sentences.text: 2. The petitioner is facing prosecution in connection with T.R. Case No.14 of 2012 for the offences under Sections 120B/420/468/471/467 of I.P.C. read with Sections 13(2)/13(1)(d) of the P.C. Act pending in the Court of the learned Special Judge, C.B.I.-I, Bhubaneswar.

entities.text: Court of the learned Special Judge, C.B.I.-I, Bhubaneswar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
On 17.08.2024, he could not present in the Court because of the confusion that the case has been transferred from the Court of the learned Special Judge CBI-II,
Bhubaneswar to the Court of the learned Special Judge, CBI-I, Bhubaneswar, which led to issuance of the NBW against him on 17.09.2024.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the NBW issued on 17.08.2024 was not be executed.
Hence, the said order was repeated by the learned Court below on 17.09.2024.

5. Learned counsel for the petitioner on instruction from his client undertakes that his client would be appearing before the Court below on or before 30th November, 2024 and seeks appropriate remedy available to him under law.

6. Taking into consideration the above facts and submission at the Bar, the orders dated 17.08.2024 & 17.09.2024 passed by the learned Special Judge, C.B.I.-I, Bhubaneswar in T.R. Case No.14 of 2012 is set aside, subject to the petitioner appearing/surrendering before the Court below on or before 30th November, 2024 and paying cost of Rs.1000/- to be deposited in the District Court Bar Association, Bhubaneswar.
